answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the terrace reference is updated at each knoll checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the willow audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 52 aliases however many keys the operator holds. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
